WITH daily AS (
  SELECT "order_date", SUM("amount") AS daily_sales
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "order_date"
)
SELECT "order_date", ROUND("daily_sales",2) AS daily_sales,
  ROUND((SELECT AVG("daily_sales") FROM daily),2) AS avg_daily_sales,
  ROUND(0.5 * (SELECT AVG("daily_sales") FROM daily),2) AS threshold
